notes.title: Bug fixes (sorry)
notes.notes:
Changes
[list]
[*] D-Pad support is now enabled by default, no more changing the bindings
[*] The cursor has returned to the main menu, and has been obliterated from the party cutscene.
[*] Fixed the bathroom door bug
[*] Target Framerate slider added under PSX settings
[*] Made the in-game content warning more specific, but also gave you a skip button if you already know what's up
[/list]

If you're a nerd and want to know what happened with the bathroom door:
There was a very small (<5%) chance you as a player would encounter an invisible object that would stick to your character model and physically block you from being able to interact with objects, like the door. This invisible object is on your model for the Masked Man's AI to have a vague knowledge of your  general location without knowing exactly where to find you. A recent update to interactions (in an attempt to make them easier for you to find) increased the chance of it sticking to you to around 90%. Sorry it took so long to track down! I am learning :)

notes.title: User Feedback Update
notes.notes:
This update addresses the major points of feedback I've gotten from the community recently. If something's bothering you, always feel free to reach out! I try to be quick with it :)

[b]In this update:[/b]
[list]
[*]  Some camera adjustments, extra settings for the player to get the cameras exactly how they'd like
[*]  You should have an easier time interacting with objects
[*]  Masked Man "hurt"  audio volume has been raised
[*]  You can pick up all the trash at once
[*]  You can hold the knife and flashlight at the same time
[*]  Players can control their turn speed under settings>general . Use this if you feel like you're hitting a wall when you turn.
[*]  The stool from the level 1 puzzle has been removed - RIP, I loved that stool
[/list]

notes.title: PSX Settings Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Minor performance improvements
[*] PSX settings fixed (Pixilation, dithering, and interlacing)
[*] Control Binding updated to support D-Pad input
[/list]

Do you hate the new cameras? You can revert to the previous camera system by:
1. Right click "Stay" in your steam library
2. Select "Manage Betas"
3. Opt into the Old_Cameras beta and update!

notes.title: We're live!
notes.notes:
We did it! Thanks again to all those who spent their time and effort to provide the feedback that shaped "Stay" into this final product.

Note: If you played an earlier iteration with forced pixilation, that is not longer an option. The post processing shader responsible for that, dithering, and texture warping were found to cause an aggressive memory leak. I hope to re-enable that feature when I find a solution.

Maintenance patches/bug fixes will be released occasionally - don't hesitate to open new threads and let me know your thoughts! Otherwise, new games in the works ~

Follow [url=https://www.instagram.com/spectraldoe/]@Spectral_Doe[/url] for regular updates.

notes.title: Playtest Concluded and New Content
notes.notes:
Thank you to all those who have participated in the play test, submitted feedback, and have supported me through various outlets like Twitch and YouTube. I've received a great amount of useful feedback and have been working hard to incorporate it into the final product! 

I have also been hiding the best (in my opinion) ending to the game up to this point, and have recently published the change to make it visible to those of you with early access. Give it another shot if you haven't seen it yet! It really highlights the initial inspiration of the game: Feminine Rage.

Forever grateful for this endlessly supportive community, and I hope to have a release ready experience by early February-- what a way to celebrate the holiday of love ❤️ 🔪
